capacity.max_guests.en: Evergreen Farm hosts events for up to 150 guests.

packages.names.en: We offer four wedding packages: Classic Day, Weekend Lite, Full Weekend and Estate Experience.

schedule.weekend_span.en: Weekend wedding packages give you the farm from Friday through Sunday, with Monday available as an extension.

schedule.one_wedding_per_weekend.en: We host only one wedding per weekend, so the farm is yours for the whole stay.

lodging.available.en: On-site lodging at the Residence is available to event guests and can be combined with a venue package.

catering.external.en: Catering is arranged by you with a caterer of your choice. We're happy to share a list of local caterers we recommend.

payment.methods.en: We accept bank transfer, Zelle and checks. Card payment is available through a Square invoice; the card processing fee is added to the invoice.

payment.structure.en: Bookings are secured with a deposit, with the balance and a refundable damage deposit due before the event.

contact.email_only.en: The best way to reach us is by email; we reply quickly.

booking.lead_time.en: Most couples book their date 12 to 18 months ahead; popular spring and fall Saturdays go first.

location.area.en: Evergreen Farm is a farm wedding venue in the Charlottesville, Virginia area.

location.address.ask_zh: 场地详细地址、从 Charlottesville 市区的车程？

location.directions.ask_zh: 导航要点：路口、未铺装路段、手机信号？

location.nearby.ask_zh: 最近的酒店、机场和车程？

spaces.ceremony.ask_zh: 仪式场地有哪些，各容纳多少人？

spaces.reception.ask_zh: 宴会场地（谷仓/帐篷/室外）和容量？

spaces.rain_plan.ask_zh: 下雨时的备用方案？室内空间容量？

spaces.parking.ask_zh: 停车位数量，是否需要摆渡车？

inclusions.furniture.ask_zh: 套餐包含哪些桌椅、桌布、餐具？

inclusions.setup_teardown.ask_zh: 布置和撤场的时间窗口，由谁负责？

inclusions.rehearsal.ask_zh: 是否包含彩排时间、彩排晚宴场地？

inclusions.staff.ask_zh: 活动当天是否有场地负责人在场？

rules.end_time.ask_zh: 音乐和活动结束时间（噪音规定）？

rules.alcohol.ask_zh: 酒水政策：自带、需持证酒保、保险？

rules.vendors.ask_zh: 对供应商的要求（保险、名单限制）？

rules.decor.ask_zh: 装饰限制：明火、烟花、彩纸？

rules.pets.ask_zh: 是否允许宠物参加仪式？

rules.insurance.ask_zh: 是否要求客人购买活动责任险？

access.utilities.ask_zh: 电力、用水、Wi-Fi 情况（供应商会问）？

lodging.residence_details.ask_zh: Residence 几间卧室、可住几人、入住退房时间？

lodging.residence_rate.ask_zh: Residence 提供给活动客人的价格或是否含在套餐内？

small_events.offer.ask_zh: 小型活动和公司活动的标准报价方式（按人数、时长）？

brand.story.ask_zh: 农场的故事：历史、家庭、为什么做场地？用于简介和文章。
